preconditions.description: The input must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(num, int) for num in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list must be integers.

postconditions.description: The returned integer is in the input list.

postconditions.expression: len(str(return_value)) == max(len(str(num)) for num in numbers)
postconditions.description: The returned integer has the most digits among the numbers in the list.
